name: FlitAgent – MCP Server to manage your sites by ChatGPT, Claude & other AI agents
author: FlitAgent

sections.description:
FlitAgent lets Claude, ChatGPT and other AI apps work on your WordPress site. Ask in plain words for a health check, a content fix or a plugin update. The AI proposes the change, you see a before-and-after preview in wp-admin, and you approve or reject it. Every change gets a receipt, and most can be rolled back.

FlitAgent needs a free flitagent.com account, which relays requests between your AI app and your site (see External services). The Free plan includes 100 tool calls a day.

An MCP server for WordPress

FlitAgent gives your site a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Your AI app connects once to https://mcp.flitagent.com/, and flitagent.com relays each request to your site. Every action is a named tool with checked inputs, and no tool runs SQL queries or shell commands.

Connect Claude to WordPress

Add https://mcp.flitagent.com/ to Claude as a custom connector, and log in to flitagent.com when Claude asks.

Connect ChatGPT to WordPress

Add https://mcp.flitagent.com/ to ChatGPT as a connector, and log in to flitagent.com when ChatGPT asks.

Connect Claude Code, Codex and other MCP apps

Any MCP app that supports remote servers with OAuth sign-in works. FlitAgent > Connect has the steps for each app, and the commands to copy for Claude Code and Codex.

What your AI app can do

  • Check the site. get_health_triage finds pending updates, inactive plugins and themes, overdue cron tasks, PHP errors shown to visitors and critical Site Health issues, and, where FlitAgent can fix one, names the tool that does. get_content_qa finds missing alt text, broken internal links, SEO basics and stale content.
  • Change content and settings. Posts and pages, terms, comments, media, users and roles, settings, menus, widgets, block templates and global styles, plus cache and cron tasks. Several fixes can go in one plan with one approval.
  • Keep the site up to date. Install, update and delete plugins and themes, and update WordPress core. After an update, FlitAgent loads the home page and warns you if it shows an error.
  • WooCommerce. Read products, orders and a store overview. FlitAgent has no tools of its own that change orders, prices or stock.
  • Elementor. Read layouts, and save them after your approval.
  • WordPress abilities. On WordPress 6.9 or later, list and run the abilities that WordPress and other plugins register.

You stay in control

  • Approvals. Every change shows a before-and-after preview and waits in FlitAgent > Approvals. You can turn on auto-approve for low-risk content, term, comment and cache tools, and for rollbacks. Plugin, theme and core updates, permanent deletions, plans and changes that can’t be rolled back (other than clearing a cache) always wait.
  • Receipts. Every change gets a receipt in FlitAgent > Activity, naming the app that asked and how it was approved.
  • Rollback. Your AI app can roll back most changes by their receipt. Changes that belong to a theme, such as Additional CSS, menu locations and widgets, roll back only while that theme is active. If a change can’t be rolled back, its summary says so before you approve it.
  • Access. One setting covers every AI tool: Read and propose changes (the default) or Read only. Change it at any time under FlitAgent > Settings.
  • Connections. FlitAgent > Connect shows the connection and each AI tool that reached your site. Disconnect one tool, or the whole site, from there.

Who FlitAgent is for

  • Site owners who want to ask what needs fixing and approve the fix.
  • Developers who work in Claude Code, Codex or another MCP app.
  • Agencies: one flitagent.com account connects up to 50 sites, each with its own approvals and receipts.

Source code

https://github.com/FlitAgent/flitagent

Resources

  • Website: https://flitagent.com
  • Connect your AI app: https://flitagent.com/connect/
  • Documentation: https://flitagent.com/docs/
  • Plans and pricing: https://flitagent.com/pricing/
  • Security: https://flitagent.com/security/

External services

FlitAgent needs the flitagent.com service. Nothing is sent to it before an administrator clicks Connect.

  • flitagent.com connects your AI apps to this site. When you click Connect, your browser takes this site’s address to flitagent.com, where you log in, choose the access and approve the site. After that, your AI app’s requests and their results pass through flitagent.com and are not stored there. flitagent.com keeps usage metadata and basic details about the site: its name, address, access, versions and connection status. The plugin also checks flitagent.com’s security keys, and tells it when you disconnect or set up an AI tool, disconnect the site or delete the plugin, and when FlitAgent > Connect opens; these messages carry no more than the connection id. Terms of service, privacy policy
  • WordPress.org for checksums, plugin searches, plugin and theme lookups when a change is proposed, and package downloads only after your approval, with the same data WordPress sends from wp-admin. Privacy policy
  • Files you approve. upload_media_from_url downloads the file at the address the AI app gives, only after you approve it.

Privacy

FlitAgent keeps its change requests, approvals and receipts in its own tables on your site, and the connection to flitagent.com and the AI apps that reached your site in its settings. It holds no passwords or tokens for your AI apps. Deleting the plugin always removes the connection and tells flitagent.com to disconnect the site; if flitagent.com can’t be reached, disconnect the site in your flitagent.com account. By default it also removes the receipts, change sets and settings; untick the option under FlitAgent > Settings to keep them for a reinstall.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate FlitAgent, and create a free account at https://flitagent.com.
  2. The setup guide checks HTTPS, permalinks, the MCP endpoint and custom request headers, and shows a fix for each problem.
  3. Click Connect to flitagent.com, log in, choose the access and approve the site.
  4. Under FlitAgent > Connect, click Set up for your AI app and follow its steps.

The site needs a public HTTPS address: local and private sites can’t connect. On multisite, AI apps can read the site but not change it yet.
sections.faq:
My site can’t connect. What should I check?

The setup guide checks HTTPS, permalinks, the MCP endpoint and custom request headers, and shows a fix for each problem. The site also needs a public HTTPS address: flitagent.com can’t reach local and private sites.

Is FlitAgent free? Do I need an AI subscription?

The plugin is free. The flitagent.com Free plan includes 100 tool calls a day across all your sites, and paid plans raise the limit: see plans and pricing. You use your own Claude, ChatGPT or other AI app account.

Which AI apps work with FlitAgent?

Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex and any other MCP app that supports remote servers with OAuth sign-in.

Is FlitAgent a WordPress MCP server?

Yes. Your AI app connects to https://mcp.flitagent.com/, which relays each tool call to your site. The tools run on your site, as the administrator who connected it.

Can the AI change my site without me?

Only if you allow it. Every change waits for your approval in FlitAgent > Approvals, unless you turn on auto-approve for a low-risk tool. You can also set access to Read only.

Can the AI break my site?

Every change shows a preview first, and plugin, theme and core updates and permanent deletions always wait for you. After an update, FlitAgent checks the home page for errors, and most changes can be rolled back. Keep your usual backups too.

Who can connect?

An administrator connects the site, and requests from your AI apps act as that user. If that user loses administrator access, requests are refused until an administrator connects again.

Does FlitAgent send my data to flitagent.com?

Only after an administrator clicks Connect. Your AI app’s requests and their results pass through flitagent.com and are not stored there. flitagent.com keeps usage metadata (raw events for 90 days, daily totals for 25 months) and basic details about the site. See External services.

Why can’t an administrator change another administrator through FlitAgent on my host?

Some hosts turn off plugin and theme installs in a way FlitAgent can’t tell apart from a limit on one user, so FlitAgent refuses changes to other administrators there. Make them in wp-admin instead.

Can I connect more than one site?

Yes. One flitagent.com account connects up to 50 sites, on every plan. They share the account’s daily limit, which resets at midnight UTC.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. You ask in plain words, and approve or reject each change on a screen that shows what will change.

screenshots.caption: A change waiting for approval: what it will change, before and after, the exact arguments that will run, and Approve or Reject.
Approvals: every change an AI app proposed, which app asked and as which user, with a Review button for each.
Activity: a receipt for every change made, refused or failed, with how it was approved and whether it can be rolled back.
